hooks.command:
sh -c '
  timeout -k 1 3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/agents_extensions/shared/hooks/precompact-handoff-guard.sh"
  status=$?
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ] && exit 2
  printf "%s\n" "Claude driver compaction refused: use thread-rollover (scripts/orchestration/thread_handoff.py prepare), print HANDOFF-DONE <path>, and exit." >&2
  exit 2
'
